title: Automated Logistics Feedback Loop
business: A regional logistics firm managing hundreds of daily last-mile delivery drivers.
problem: The operations team struggles to manually aggregate driver feedback regarding route hazards, leading to delayed safety updates and increased risk of delivery incidents.
solution: By integrating the Jotform connector with Claude, the operations team can programmatically generate safety reporting forms and use natural language to instantly synthesize driver-submitted hazard reports into actionable safety briefings.
steps: Use the create_form tool to generate a standardized Driver Hazard Report form with specific fields for location, hazard type, and severity.
Distribute the form link to the driver fleet via existing communication channels.
Invoke the analyze_submissions tool to process incoming data, requesting Claude to identify recurring safety themes or high-risk geographic clusters.
Refine the form structure using the edit_form tool if drivers report difficulty with specific input fields during the pilot phase.
outcome: The operations team achieves a streamlined feedback loop where safety data is transformed into summarized insights without manual spreadsheet consolidation, enabling faster response times to route hazards.
limitation: The connector relies on the accuracy of natural language prompts; if the user provides ambiguous instructions for data analysis, the resulting summary may overlook subtle trends or miscategorize specific feedback entries.

options: The connector cannot create forms with more than five fields.
The system requires manual coding for every analysis request.
